mapper.sql: SELECT r.record_id, r.plan_id, r.course_id, r.trainer_id, r.course_name, r.course_type, r.training_date, r.training_location, r.hours, r.trainer, r.attachment, r.enterprise_id, r.del_flag, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_safety_training_attendee a WHERE a.record_id = r.record_id AND a.del_flag = '0') AS attendee_count FROM biz_safety_training_record r
mapper.select: SELECT record_id, plan_id, course_id, trainer_id, course_name, course_type, training_date, training_location, hours, trainer, attachment, enterprise_id, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM biz_safety_training_record WHERE record_id = #{recordId}

SELECT attendee_id, record_id, user_id, user_name, dept_id, dept_name, sign_in_status, sign_in_time, sign_in_method, exam_score, is_pass, exam_time, enterprise_id, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM biz_safety_training_attendee WHERE record_id = #{recordId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY create_time ASC
mapper.delete: UPDATE biz_safety_training_record SET del_flag = '2' WHERE record_id = #{recordId}
UPDATE biz_safety_training_record SET del_flag = '2' WHERE record_id IN #{recordId}
